summary.text: Alina Bonsell is the Republican and Block Mamdani Party nominee challenging incumbent Liz Krueger. A 20-year East Side resident who says she came to the U.S. as a child when her family fled the Soviet Union as Jewish refugees, she describes a career in the pharmaceutical, biotech, healthcare and private sectors. She previously ran unsuccessfully for New York City Council District 5 in 2025 and is running on public safety, tax relief and economic growth.

paragraphs.text: According to her Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey, she came to the United States as a child when her family fled the Soviet Union as Jewish refugees; in an earlier survey response she said her family immigrated in 1989 when she was a small child.
Earned a bachelor's degree from Hofstra University.
Describes approximately 20 years of professional experience in the pharmaceutical, biotech, and healthcare private sectors (an earlier survey response gave 15 years).
Describes herself as a mother and a 20-year resident of Manhattan's East Side.
Ran for New York City Council District 5 in 2025 on the Republican line and lost to incumbent Julie Menin, 73.7% to 26.0%.
Advanced without a primary opponent in the June 2026 Republican primary for State Senate District 28 and also holds the Block Mamdani Party line.

sources.title: Alina Bonsell - Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey (submitted June 8, 2026)
